core_problem_solved: To provide a modern, generics-enabled, and rich set of extensions to the standard Java Collections Framework, serving as the official successor to the original `commons-collections`.
key_features: Full support for Java Generics, providing type safety
New collection types like `BidiMap` (bidirectional map) and `Bag` (multiset)
Powerful utility classes (`CollectionUtils`, `ListUtils`, etc.) for common operations
A redesigned API to be safer and more robust than its predecessor
era_and_niche: The modern, official collections utility library from the Apache Commons project. It is the direct, actively maintained successor to the original, non-generic, and insecure `commons-collections`.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete** and is actively maintained. However, it faces very strong competition from **`com.google.guava:guava`**, which is often considered the de facto industry standard for a third-party collections and utility library in modern Java development due to its modern API design and broader feature set.
